lines.t: Use: Constructs a sharpening wheel that grants you and others sitting nearby [(60 < 24 ? 6 : (60 < 38 ? 11 : (60 < 52 ? 20 : 34)))] increased Strength, mutually exclusive with Strength of Earth Totem.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places an anvil, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places a Master Forge usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
